roadmap.title: Base game first jobs
roadmap.description: Buy a truck, deliver jobs, earn money, park trailers and use stations.

roadmap.title: Driving Academy
roadmap.description: Complete the Truck Driving Basics, Proficiency and Double Trailer scenarios.

roadmap.title: California, Nevada and Arizona
roadmap.description: Explore the three original states and finish their city, port, quarry and sight goals.

roadmap.title: Heavy Cargo, Special Transport and Forest Machinery
roadmap.description: Haul oversize, heavy and timber cargo.

roadmap.title: Mountain West and New Mexico
roadmap.description: Explore New Mexico, Utah, Colorado, Wyoming and Montana.

roadmap.title: Texas and the Plains
roadmap.description: Explore Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, Nebraska and Arkansas.

roadmap.title: Midwest, South and South Dakota
roadmap.description: Explore Missouri, Iowa, Louisiana, Illinois and South Dakota.

roadmap.title: Road Trip
roadmap.description: Buy and drive a car for the Road Trip goals.

achievements.description: Discover at least 15 cities in California
achievements.summary: Find 15 or more cities in California by driving into them.

steps.text: Drive into 15 California cities, for example Los Angeles, San Diego, Fresno and Sacramento.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to a port in Oakland and a port in San Francisco
achievements.summary: Deliver a load to a seaport in Oakland and another to a seaport in San Francisco.

steps.text: Deliver a load to @loc{Oakland Shippers} in Oakland.
Deliver a load to @loc{Port of San Francisco} in San Francisco.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo from at least 3 vineyards in California
achievements.summary: Take loads that begin at 3 or more different California vineyards and deliver them.

guide.context: The vineyard company is @loc{Mon Coeur}. Its sites are in San Diego, Sacramento, Ukiah and Fresno.

steps.text: Take a job that starts at a @loc{Mon Coeur} vineyard in California.
Repeat with two other Mon Coeur sites.

achievements.description: Drive 10,000 miles during deliveries
achievements.summary: Drive 10,000 miles during deliveries.

steps.text: Keep taking jobs until the delivery miles total 10,000.

achievements.description: Buy your own truck
achievements.summary: Buy your own truck.

steps.text: Visit a @loc{truck dealer} and buy a truck.

achievements.description: Perform deliveries for at least 15 different companies
achievements.summary: Deliver for 15 or more different companies.

steps.text: Take jobs from or to different companies until you have delivered for 15 of them.

achievements.description: Complete a perfect delivery (no damage, no fines, in-time) for a job that is at least 600 miles
achievements.summary: Finish one job of 600 miles or more with no damage, no fines and on schedule.

steps.text: Take a job of 600 miles or more and finish it with no damage, no fines and on time.

achievements.description: Earn $100,000 delivering cargos
achievements.summary: Earn $100,000 from deliveries.

steps.text: Keep completing deliveries until your delivery earnings total $100,000.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade one of your garages
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade one of your garages.

steps.text: Buy a garage, then buy every upgrade for it.
steps.note: A bank loan can speed this up.

achievements.description: Successfully park a trailer at a delivery point
achievements.summary: Park a trailer successfully at a delivery location.

steps.text: After delivering a trailer, choose the middle parking option and park the trailer in the marked spot.

achievements.description: Successfully park a trailer at a hard delivery point
achievements.summary: Park a trailer correctly at a delivery point set to hard parking.

steps.text: Finish a delivery and choose the hard trailer parking option, then park the trailer in the marked spot.

achievements.description: Finish 50 deliveries
achievements.summary: Finish 50 deliveries.

steps.text: Complete 50 jobs.

achievements.description: Buy, design and apply a custom paintjob
achievements.summary: Pay for a custom paintjob you designed and put it on a truck.

steps.text: Own a truck, drive to a @loc{service station}, then buy, design and apply a paint job.

achievements.description: Use a weigh station
achievements.summary: Use a weigh station.

steps.text: Drive through a weigh station on the road.

achievements.description: Use a gas station
achievements.summary: Use a gas station.

steps.text: Drive into a gas station and refuel your truck.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Nevada
achievements.summary: Drive into 8 or more different cities in Nevada to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Nevada cities until 8 are discovered, for example @loc{Winnemucca}, @loc{Tonopah}, @loc{Reno}, @loc{Primm}, @loc{Pioche}, @loc{Las Vegas}, @loc{Jackpot}, @loc{Ely}, @loc{Elko}, @loc{Carson City}.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 1 quarry in Nevada
achievements.summary: Bring a load to any quarry in Nevada.

steps.text: Deliver a job to a Coastline Mining quarry, either northwest of @loc{Elko} or southeast of @loc{Carson City}.

achievements.description: Discover at least 12 cities in Arizona
achievements.summary: Find 12 or more cities in Arizona by driving into them.

steps.text: Drive into 12 Arizona cities, for example Phoenix, Tucson, Flagstaff and Yuma.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to the Phoenix Airport
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to the Phoenix Airport.

steps.text: Deliver a load to @loc{Phoenix Freight}, east of Phoenix.

achievements.description: Get on the start of the Truck Racing circuit
achievements.summary: Reach the starting line of the Truck Racing circuit in Arizona.

steps.text: Drive to the @loc{Bitumen} company west of Tucson.
Drive over the cones to reach the circuit start.

achievements.description: Visit at least 4 Colorado River sights
achievements.summary: Stop at 4 or more scenic spots along the Colorado River in Arizona.

steps.text: Drive to four of the river sights, such as north of @loc{Yuma} on Route 8 and south of @loc{Kingman} on Route 40.

achievements.description: Deliver first Heavy Cargo Pack job (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver your first Heavy Cargo Pack job.

steps.text: Take a Heavy Cargo Pack job from the job list and deliver it.

achievements.description: Use truck scale or weigh station with gross vehicle weight of at least 175,000 lbs (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Get weighed at a truck scale or weigh station while your total vehicle weight is 175,000 lbs or more.

guide.context: Choose the heaviest load available, use a sleeper-cab truck, and fill the fuel tank before weighing.

steps.text: Take a @item{Transformer} job with a sleeper-cab truck and fill the tank to the maximum.
Drive onto a @mechanic{weigh station} or truck scale.

achievements.displayName: Heavy, but Not Bull in a China Shop!
achievements.description: Complete excellent delivery of a cargo from the Heavy Cargo Pack which is at least 1,000 miles long (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish a Heavy Cargo Pack job of 1,000 miles or more with an excellent delivery result.

guide.context: The route has to read above 1,000 miles at the moment you accept the job.

steps.text: Accept a Heavy Cargo Pack job over 1,000 miles.
Deliver it on time with no damage and no fines.

achievements.description: Earn $100,000 on 5 consecutive Heavy Cargo Pack deliveries (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Make a total of $100,000 across five Heavy Cargo Pack deliveries done back to back.

guide.context: Deliver nothing but Heavy Cargo Pack jobs during the streak.

steps.text: Take 5 Heavy Cargo Pack jobs in a row, choosing long, well-paid ones.
Check that the five deliveries together pay over $100,000.

achievements.displayName: I Thought This Should Be Heavy?!
achievements.description: Complete a delivery of at least 8 unique cargoes from the Heavy Cargo Pack (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver 8 or more different cargo types from the Heavy Cargo Pack.

guide.context: Special Transport cargoes do not count. Use the cargo filter in the job window to find each load.

steps.text: Deliver 8 different Heavy Cargo Pack cargoes, such as @item{All Terrain Crane}, @item{Scraper}, @item{Transformer} and @item{Lift Truck}.

achievements.description: Discover at least 10 cities in New Mexico (requires New Mexico DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 10 or more different cities in New Mexico to find them.

steps.text: Drive to New Mexico cities until 10 are discovered, for example @loc{Tucumcari}, @loc{Socorro}, @loc{Santa Fe}, @loc{Roswell}, @loc{Raton}, @loc{Las Cruces}, @loc{Hobbs}, @loc{Gallup}, @loc{Farmington}, @loc{Clovis}, @loc{Carlsbad}, @loc{Artesia}, @loc{Albuquerque}, @loc{Alamogordo}.

achievements.description: Visit at least 18 large truck stops and rest stops in New Mexico (requires New Mexico DLC)
achievements.summary: Visit 18 or more of the big truck stops and rest stops across New Mexico.

guide.context: Drive the full entrance and exit roads of each stop so every road around it is discovered.

steps.text: Drive to large truck stops and rest stops across New Mexico until 18 are visited.

achievements.description: Discover shortcut through the forest (requires New Mexico DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover the shortcut through the forest in New Mexico.

steps.text: Drive Route 64 between @loc{Raton} and @loc{Farmington} to find the forest shortcut.

achievements.description: Drive by the Billy The Kid Museum (requires New Mexico DLC)
achievements.summary: Pass the Billy The Kid Museum in New Mexico.

steps.text: Drive past the @loc{Billy The Kid Museum}, west of @loc{Clovis} on Route 60.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to An-124 depot (requires New Mexico DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to the An-124 depot in New Mexico.

steps.text: Find a New Mexico job whose destination is the An-124 depot and deliver it.

achievements.description: Successfully deliver a Special Transport DLC mission with no damage and on time (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver any Special Transport job with no damage and on time.

steps.text: Take any Special Transport job and deliver it with no damage, on time.

achievements.description: Complete deliveries on at least 10 oversize routes in base game (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete deliveries on 10 oversize routes in the base game.

steps.text: Complete oversize-load deliveries on ten different base-game routes.

achievements.description: Successfully deliver a Helicopter Special Transport DLC mission with no damage and on time (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver a Helicopter Special Transport job with no damage and on time.

steps.text: Take the @item{Helicopter} Special Transport job and deliver it with no damage, on time.

achievements.description: Successfully deliver an Air Conditioning Complex Special Transport DLC mission with no damage and on time (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish the Air Conditioning Complex Special Transport mission undamaged and on schedule.

steps.text: Take the @item{Air Conditioning Complex} Special Transport job and deliver it with no damage, on time.

achievements.description: Complete at least 10 unique deliveries of oversize cargoes (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete 10 different oversize cargo deliveries.

steps.text: Deliver ten different oversize cargo types.

achievements.description: Deliver all three parts of a disassembled dumper: Haul Truck Hull, Huge Tyres, Haul Truck Chassis (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver the Haul Truck Hull, Huge Tyres and Haul Truck Chassis, the three pieces of one taken-apart dumper.

steps.text: Deliver a @item{Haul Truck Hull}.
Deliver @item{Huge Tyres}.
Deliver a @item{Haul Truck Chassis}.

achievements.description: Successfully deliver a Turnkey House Special Transport DLC mission with no damage and on time (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver a Turnkey House Special Transport job with no damage and on time.

steps.text: Take the @item{Turnkey House} Special Transport job and deliver it with no damage, on time.

achievements.description: Discover at least 10 cities in Oregon (requires Oregon DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 10 cities in Oregon.

steps.text: Drive into ten Oregon cities.

achievements.description: Travel across the New Youngs Bay Bridge (requires Oregon DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive across the New Youngs Bay Bridge in Oregon.

steps.text: Drive your truck across the @loc{New Youngs Bay Bridge}.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo from at least 4 timber harvest sites in Oregon (requires Oregon DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo from 4 different timber harvest sites in Oregon.

steps.text: Pick up cargo at four different timber harvest sites in Oregon and deliver each load.

achievements.description: Discover following landmarks of Oregon: Crater Lake, Crooked River Gorge, Thor's Well and Yaquina Head Lighthouse (requires Oregon DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover these four Oregon landmarks: Yaquina Head Lighthouse, Thor's Well, Crooked River Gorge and Crater Lake.

steps.text: Reach these four places: @loc{Thor's Well}, @loc{Crater Lake}, @loc{Yaquina Head Lighthouse} and @loc{Crooked River Gorge}.

achievements.description: Complete a delivery of vegetables over Cabbage Hill (requires Oregon DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete a vegetable delivery that goes over Cabbage Hill in Oregon.

steps.text: Take a vegetable delivery whose route crosses @loc{Cabbage Hill} in Oregon, and finish the job.

achievements.description: Discover at least 12 cities in Washington (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 12 cities in Washington.

steps.text: Drive into twelve Washington cities. Options include Seattle, Tacoma, Spokane, Olympia, Yakima and Vancouver.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to an aerospace company in Washington (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Make a cargo delivery to an aerospace company in Washington.

steps.text: Deliver cargo to the company Darwing, south of @loc{Everett}, with a normal job.

achievements.description: Deliver a boat to a marina in Washington (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Bring a boat to a Washington marina.

steps.text: Deliver a boat to a Sea Horizon marina.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 1 port terminal in Washington (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to a port terminal in Washington.

steps.text: Deliver cargo to Port of Tacoma or Port of Seattle.

achievements.description: Drive through both Seattle tunnels (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive through both Seattle tunnels.

steps.text: Drive through the tunnels north and east of @loc{Seattle}, on Route 5 and Route 90.

achievements.description: Use a ferry to cross the water (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Cross the water on a ferry in Washington.

steps.text: Take the ferry between @loc{Everett} and @loc{Port Angeles}.

achievements.description: Drive through the forest road to timber harvest in Bellingham (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive the forest road to the timber harvest in Bellingham.

steps.text: Enter the road east of @loc{Bellingham} on Route 20. Drive to the Deepgrove Forest Products timber harvest.

achievements.description: Visit Mount St. Helens, Grand Coulee Dam, Mount Rainier (requires Washington DLC)
achievements.summary: Reach Mount Rainier, Mount St. Helens and Grand Coulee Dam in Washington.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Mount Rainier} and @loc{Mount St. Helens}, both on Route 12.
Then drive to @loc{Grand Coulee} and visit the dam.

achievements.description: Complete delivery of at least 4 Forest Machinery DLC cargoes (requires Forest Machinery DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete a delivery of at least 4 different Forest Machinery DLC cargoes.

steps.text: Deliver four different Forest Machinery cargoes.

achievements.description: Complete a perfect delivery (no damage, no fines, in-time) of at least 3 Forest Machinery DLC jobs (requires Forest Machinery DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete at least 3 perfect Forest Machinery DLC deliveries, with no damage, no fines and on time.

steps.text: Deliver three Forest Machinery jobs on time with no damage and no fines.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Utah (requires Utah DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 8 cities in Utah.

steps.text: Drive into eight Utah cities. Options include Moab, Provo, Ogden, Logan, Salina and Cedar City.

achievements.description: Visit at least 2 mines and quarries in Utah (requires Utah DLC)
achievements.summary: Visit 2 mines or quarries in Utah.

steps.text: Take a job to a mine or quarry in Utah and drive until the achievement pops up. You may cancel the job.

achievements.description: Find a sign that says "nothing" (requires Utah DLC)
achievements.summary: Find the sign that says nothing in Utah.

steps.text: Drive Route 89 north between Page and St. George and turn into the first entrance on the left behind the parking lot. Find the sign.

achievements.description: Take a job from each branch of at least 6 companies located in Salt Lake City (requires Utah DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver jobs for 6 different companies located in Salt Lake City.

guide.context: Taking a job is not enough; the cargo must be delivered. Companies with two branches need a new branch each time.

steps.text: Complete deliveries for six Salt Lake City companies. Companies in the city: A-Steel, Coastline Mining, Plaster & Sons, Sell Goods, Apade, Shop Town.

achievements.description: Deliver frac tank trailer to at least 5 oil drilling sites in Utah (requires Utah DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver frac tank trailers to 5 different oil drilling sites in Utah.

steps.text: Search for @item{Frac Tank} jobs for the company Gallon.
Deliver to five different drilling areas, not the same area twice. Sites are near Vernal, Price and Moab.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Idaho (requires Idaho DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 8 or more different cities in Idaho to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Idaho cities until 8 are discovered.

achievements.description: Complete five deliveries of potatoes from Idaho farms (requires Idaho DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish five potato deliveries that start at farms in Idaho.

steps.text: Take @item{Potatoes} jobs that start at farms in Idaho and finish 5 of them.

achievements.description: Complete perfect deliveries (no damage, no fines, on time) between the following cities: Kennewick - Lewiston; Boise - Twin Falls; Twin Falls - Pocatello; Pocatello - Idaho Falls. Any order or direction counts (requires Washington and Idaho DLCs)
achievements.summary: Make a flawless delivery (no damage, no fines, on time) on each of four city pairs: Kennewick - Lewiston, Boise - Twin Falls, Twin Falls - Pocatello and Pocatello - Idaho Falls, in any order or direction.

guide.context: Kennewick is in Washington, so the Washington DLC is also needed.

steps.text: Find a job between @loc{Kennewick} and @loc{Lewiston}, in either direction, and deliver it with no damage, no fines and on time.
Do the same for @loc{Boise} - @loc{Twin Falls}.
Do the same for @loc{Twin Falls} - @loc{Pocatello}.
Do the same for @loc{Pocatello} - @loc{Idaho Falls}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 8 viewpoints in Idaho (requires Idaho DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 8 different viewpoints in Idaho.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Idaho and watch their cutscenes until 8 are viewed.

achievements.description: Visit 45th parallel in Idaho - a halfway between the Equator and the North Pole (requires Idaho DLC)
achievements.summary: Visit the 45th parallel in Idaho.

steps.text: Drive to the 45th parallel landmark in @loc{Idaho}.

achievements.description: Discover at least 10 cities in Colorado (requires Colorado DLC)
achievements.summary: Find 10 or more cities in Colorado by driving into them.

steps.text: Drive into 10 Colorado cities, for example Denver, Pueblo, Durango and Grand Junction.

achievements.description: Drive along this famously scenic and thrilling section of the U.S. 550 in Colorado (requires Colorado DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive along the scenic section of U.S. 550 in Colorado.

steps.text: Drive U.S. 550 between @loc{Montrose} and @loc{Durango}.

achievements.description: Drive through the Eisenhower-Johnson Memorial Tunnel, the highest point on the US Interstate Highway System, in both directions (requires Colorado DLC)
achievements.summary: Pass through the Eisenhower-Johnson Memorial Tunnel once in each direction.

steps.text: Drive @loc{Route 70} through the Eisenhower-Johnson Memorial Tunnel, turn around, and drive back through.

achievements.description: Deliver a Tower and Nacelle to at least 1 Vitas Power wind turbine construction site in Colorado (requires Colorado DLC)
achievements.summary: Bring both a Tower and a Nacelle to a Colorado construction site for Vitas Power wind turbines.

steps.text: Deliver a @item{Wind Turbine Tower} to a @loc{Vitas Power} construction site.
Deliver a @item{Wind Turbine Nacelle} to a Vitas Power construction site.

achievements.description: Deliver 10 loads to or from the NAMIQ company at the gold mine in Colorado (requires Colorado DLC)
achievements.summary: Haul 10 loads either to or from the NAMIQ gold mine in Colorado.

guide.context: A NAMIQ site north of the gold mines does not count.

steps.text: Take jobs to or from the @loc{NAMIQ} gold mine.
Finish 10 such loads.

achievements.description: Complete 10 deliveries to Denver Airport (requires Colorado DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete 10 deliveries to Denver Airport.

steps.text: Take jobs whose destination is @loc{Denver Air Cargo} or @loc{Ultimus} at Denver Airport.
Deliver 10 loads there.

achievements.description: Visit the famous Four Corners Monument that marks where the states of Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and Utah meet (requires Colorado DLC)
achievements.summary: Go to the Four Corners Monument, the spot shared by Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah.

steps.text: Drive to the @loc{Four Corners Monument}, northwest of Farmington.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Wyoming (requires Wyoming DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 8 cities in Wyoming.

steps.text: Drive into eight Wyoming cities. Options include Cheyenne, Casper, Jackson, Cody, Laramie and Gillette.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 8 viewpoints in Wyoming (requires Wyoming DLC)
achievements.summary: View the cutscene at 8 different viewpoints in Wyoming.

steps.text: Watch cutscenes at eight Wyoming viewpoints, for example Alpine, Bear Lake, Bighorn National Park, Boyson State Park, Cheyenne, Evanston, Devils Tower, Flaming Gorge Dam.

achievements.description: Discover and visit the town of Buford (requires Wyoming DLC)
achievements.summary: Find and enter the town of Buford in Wyoming.

steps.text: Drive to @loc{Buford}, between Cheyenne and Laramie off Route 80. Follow the street past the parking lot.

achievements.description: Deliver Train Axles, Tamping Machine and Rails to or from the rail yard in Cheyenne (requires Wyoming DLC)
achievements.summary: Move Train Axles, a Tamping Machine and Rails through the Cheyenne rail yard, as pickups or drop-offs.

steps.text: Do jobs for the company American Lines in @loc{Cheyenne}.
Take a job for each cargo in either direction: @item{Train Axles}, @item{Tamping Machine}, @item{Rails}.

achievements.description: Complete 10 excellent cattle deliveries to livestock auctions in Wyoming (requires Wyoming DLC)
achievements.summary: Make 10 excellent cattle deliveries to Wyoming livestock auctions.

guide.context: Only the Bushnell sites at Sheridan and Riverton work.

steps.text: Search for @item{Live Cattle} jobs to the company Bushnell at Sheridan or Riverton.
Finish ten of them with an excellent delivery.

achievements.description: Discover at least 12 cities in Montana (requires Montana DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 12 or more different cities in Montana to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Montana cities until 12 are discovered, for example @loc{Thompson Falls}, @loc{Sidney}, @loc{Missoula}, @loc{Miles City}, @loc{Lewistown}, @loc{Laurel}, @loc{Kalispell}, @loc{Helena}, @loc{Havre}, @loc{Great Falls}, @loc{Glendive}, @loc{Glasgow}, @loc{Butte}, @loc{Bozeman}, @loc{Billings}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 10 viewpoints in Montana (requires Montana DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 10 different viewpoints in Montana.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Montana and watch their cutscenes until 10 are viewed, such as @loc{Yellowstone National Park}, @loc{Thompson Falls}, @loc{Signal Peak Coal Mine}, @loc{Lewistown}, @loc{Great Falls}, @loc{Glacier National Park}, @loc{Fort Peck Spillway}, @loc{Flathead Lake}, @loc{Earthquake Lake}, @loc{Butte}, @loc{Billings}.

achievements.description: Show your support for zero waste by completing a total of 10 deliveries of the Dumpster Bins and Waste Paper cargoes to the Waste Transfer Stations in Montana, and at least one Garbage Truck cargo to or from anywhere in Montana (requires Montana DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish 10 deliveries of Dumpster Bins and Waste Paper to Waste Transfer Stations in Montana, and 1 Garbage Truck delivery to or from any place in Montana.

steps.text: Take @item{Dumpster Bins} and @item{Waste Paper} jobs from @loc{Municipal Waste Management} to Waste Transfer Stations in Montana until 10 are delivered.
steps.note: Search the job list by cargo name.

steps.text: Haul one @item{Garbage Truck} load starting or ending anywhere in Montana.

achievements.description: Spark up Montana and support the power network by delivering a Circuit Breakers cargo and a Utility Poles cargo to the electric substations in each of the following cities: Butte, Glasgow and Havre (requires Montana DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver one Circuit Breakers cargo and one Utility Poles cargo to the Faraday electric substations in each of Butte, Glasgow and Havre.

guide.context: Butte and Havre each have two Faraday sites, so check that the destination is the correct one.

steps.text: In @loc{Butte}, deliver one @item{Circuit Breakers} job and one @item{Utility Poles} job to @loc{Faraday}.
Do the same in @loc{Glasgow}.
Do the same in @loc{Havre}.

achievements.description: Complete excellent delivery of any machinery equipment to the Bull Mountains coal mine, Silane from the silane gas factory and Talc Powder from the talc factory (requires Montana DLC)
achievements.summary: Make excellent deliveries of Silane from the silane gas factory, Talc Powder from the talc factory, and any machinery to the Bull Mountains coal mine in Montana.

steps.text: Deliver any machinery to the Bull Mountains coal mine, the @loc{NAMIQ} Signal Peak site north of @loc{Billings}, with an excellent rating.
steps.note: Bulldozers, backhoes, road rollers and tractors count.

steps.text: Deliver @item{Silane} from the @loc{CHEMS} site in @loc{Butte} with an excellent rating.
Deliver @item{Talc Powder} from the @loc{NAMIQ} site in @loc{Butte}, or the northern one in @loc{Bozeman}, with an excellent rating.

achievements.description: Complete 20 deliveries choosing the trailer delivery option which requires reversing
achievements.summary: Complete 20 deliveries using the trailer delivery option that requires reversing.

steps.text: After delivering a trailer, pick the harder delivery option that needs reversing. Do this on 20 deliveries.

achievements.description: Discover at least 20 cities in Texas (requires Texas DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 20 cities in Texas.

steps.text: Drive into twenty Texas cities. Options include Austin, Houston, El Paso, Dallas, Amarillo and Galveston.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 25 viewpoints in Texas (requires Texas DLC)
achievements.summary: View the cutscene at 25 different viewpoints in Texas.

steps.text: Watch cutscenes at 25 Texas viewpoints. Photo mode shows which ones you have already seen.

achievements.description: Discover at least 30 historical markers in Texas (requires Texas DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 30 historical markers in Texas.

guide.context: Markers often have no hint sign, and some do not appear.

steps.text: Drive past historical markers across Texas until 30 are found. Examples: Guadalupe Peak east of El Paso, Marfa Lights south of Van Horn, Port of Beaumont in Beaumont, Tex Randall south of Amarillo.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to or from at least 2 shipyards and 4 cargo ports in Texas (requires Texas DLC)
achievements.summary: Make deliveries to or from two shipyards and four cargo ports in Texas.

steps.text: Make deliveries to or from two shipyards and four cargo ports in Texas.
Targets: Haddock Shipyard (Houston), Tera (Brownsville, Corpus Christi), Beaumont Freight Terminal, Brownsville Port, Corpus Christi Cargo Terminal, Galveston Port, Houston Cargo Terminal.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to or from at least 5 farms and 2 livestock auctions in Texas (requires Texas DLC)
achievements.summary: Make deliveries to or from five farms and two livestock auctions in Texas.

steps.text: Do jobs for the company Grand Pastures in Texas.
Make deliveries to or from five farms and two livestock auctions.

achievements.description: Complete 10 deliveries of at least one Cotton Lint, Cotton Seed and Cotton Harvester within Texas (requires Texas and Heavy Cargo Pack DLCs)
achievements.summary: Complete 10 deliveries inside Texas of Cotton Lint, Cotton Seed or Cotton Harvester.

guide.context: This achievement needs both the Texas and Heavy Cargo Pack DLCs.

steps.text: Find Cotton Lint, Cotton Seed or Cotton Harvester jobs that start and end in Texas.
Finish ten of them.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Oklahoma (requires Oklahoma DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 8 cities in Oklahoma.

steps.text: Drive into eight of these Oklahoma cities. Choices: Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Enid, Lawton, Woodward, Guymon, Clinton, Idabel, McAlester and Ardmore.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 6 viewpoints in Oklahoma (requires Oklahoma DLC)
achievements.summary: View the cutscene at 6 different viewpoints in Oklahoma.

steps.text: Drive to six of the Oklahoma viewpoints and watch each cutscene. Choices: Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Woodward, McAlester, Ardmore, Boise City, Gloss Mountain State Park, the Lawton Tyre Factory, Beavers Bend State Park and Hugo Lake Spillway.

achievements.description: Deliver 5 Bus Hood cargoes to and 5 School Bus cargoes from the bus factory in Tulsa (requires Oklahoma DLC)
achievements.summary: Bring 5 Bus Hood loads to the Tulsa bus factory and carry 5 School Bus loads away from it.

steps.text: Deliver 5 @item{Bus Hood} jobs to the @loc{Yelco} bus factory in @loc{Tulsa}.
Deliver 5 @item{School Bus} jobs that start at the same factory.
steps.note: Searching for Yelco finds both kinds of job.

achievements.description: Complete 3 deliveries of Big Tyres cargo from at least 1 tyre factory in Lawton or Ardmore (requires Oklahoma DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish 3 deliveries of Big Tyres that start at a tyre factory in Lawton or Ardmore.

steps.text: Take @item{Big Tyres} jobs from the @loc{Dynamix} tyre factory in @loc{Lawton} or @loc{Ardmore} and deliver 3 of them.
steps.note: Search for Dynamix; the cargo may be spelled Big Tires.

achievements.description: Discover at least 10 cities in Kansas (requires Kansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 10 or more different cities in Kansas to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Kansas cities until 10 are discovered, for example @loc{Wichita}, @loc{Topeka}, @loc{Salina}, @loc{Pittsburg}, @loc{Phillipsburg}, @loc{Marysville}, @loc{Kansas City}, @loc{Junction City}, @loc{Hutchinson}, @loc{Hays}, @loc{Garden City}, @loc{Emporia}, @loc{Dodge City}, @loc{Colby}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 7 viewpoints in Kansas (requires Kansas DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 7 different viewpoints in Kansas.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Kansas and watch their cutscenes until 7 are viewed, such as @loc{Bazaar Cattle Pens}, @loc{El Dorado}, @loc{Dodge City}, @loc{Hutchinson} elevators, @loc{Junction City}, @loc{Kansas City}, @loc{Butler County Line}, @loc{Monument Rocks} and @loc{Mount Sunflower}.

achievements.description: Deliver an Aircraft Wing and Jet Engine Inlets to or from at least 2 aviation depots in Wichita (requires Kansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Make one Aircraft Wing delivery and one Jet Engine Inlets delivery, each to or from a Wichita aviation depot, using at least 2 different depots in total.

steps.text: Deliver an @item{Aircraft Wing} job to or from one Wichita aviation depot and a @item{Jet Engine Inlets} job to or from another: @loc{Darwing}, @loc{Wichita Sky Harbor} or @loc{Global Sky Service}.
steps.note: Search the job list for the cargo name.

achievements.description: Discover at least 3 unmarked roads in Kansas (requires Kansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Find 3 or more unmarked roads in Kansas.

steps.text: Drive the hidden roads that lead to @loc{Monument Rocks}, south of @loc{Colby}, and to @loc{Mount Sunflower}.
Find and drive more unmarked roads in Kansas until 3 are discovered.

achievements.description: Complete 6 deliveries from the Hutchinson Salt Mine in Kansas. At least 2 deliveries must be to a Food Factory (requires Kansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish 6 jobs that start at the Hutchinson Salt Mine in Kansas, with 2 or more of them ending at a Food Factory.

guide.context: Food Factory jobs are rare. The Flavorfair factories are in Hays, Salina, Junction City and Topeka.

steps.text: Take jobs from the @loc{NAMIQ} Hutchinson Salt Mine until you have finished 6 of them.
Make sure at least 2 of those jobs end at a Food Factory such as @loc{Flavorfair}.
steps.note: A sliding tarp or dry van trailer can help you find these jobs.

achievements.description: Discover at least 10 cities in Nebraska (requires Nebraska DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 10 or more different cities in Nebraska to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Nebraska cities until 10 are discovered, for example @loc{Valentine}, @loc{Sidney}, @loc{Scottsbluff}, @loc{Omaha}, @loc{North Platte}, @loc{Norfolk}, @loc{McCook}, @loc{Lincoln}, @loc{Grand Island}, @loc{Columbus}, @loc{Chadron}, @loc{Alliance}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 6 viewpoints in Nebraska (requires Nebraska DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 6 different viewpoints in Nebraska.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Nebraska and watch their cutscenes until 6 are viewed, such as @loc{Scotts Bluff National Monument}, @loc{Scott Lookout Tower}, @loc{Lake McConaughy}, @loc{Golden Spike Tower}, @loc{Chimney Rock}, @loc{Carhenge}, @loc{Brownville Boat}.

achievements.description: Complete 3 deliveries from the Utility Vehicle Factory in Lincoln to RV dealers in Omaha, Norfolk, and Columbus (requires Nebraska DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish 3 jobs that leave the Lincoln Utility Vehicle Factory, headed to the RV dealers in Columbus, Norfolk and Omaha.

steps.text: Take jobs from the @loc{Outrider} factory in @loc{Lincoln} to @loc{Wanderlust RV} dealers, one each in @loc{Columbus}, @loc{Norfolk} and @loc{Omaha}.
steps.note: A lowboy trailer can make these jobs easier to find.

achievements.description: Complete one delivery of corn, grain, potatoes and soybean from or within Nebraska (requires Nebraska DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver one load each of corn, grain, potatoes and soybeans, starting in or staying inside Nebraska.

steps.text: Take one job each for @item{Maize}, @item{Grain}, @item{Potatoes} and @item{Soybean} that start in Nebraska and finish them.
steps.note: Corn is listed as Maize in the job search.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Arkansas (requires Arkansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Find 8 or more cities in Arkansas by driving into them.

steps.text: Drive across the city limits of 8 Arkansas cities, for example Little Rock, Hot Springs, Fort Smith and Jonesboro.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 8 viewpoints in Arkansas (requires Arkansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Watch the cutscene at 8 or more different viewpoints in Arkansas.

steps.text: Visit 8 Arkansas viewpoints, for example Little Rock, Hot Springs, Fort Smith and Norfolk Lake.

achievements.description: Complete 3 deliveries of Logs to Chuck & Jack's, and 3 deliveries of Wood Shavings to Page & Price Paper, within Arkansas (requires Arkansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Inside Arkansas, make 3 Logs deliveries to Chuck & Jack's and 3 Wood Shavings deliveries to Page & Price Paper.

guide.context: Both ends of each job must be in Arkansas, so avoid Texarkana in Texas.

steps.text: Deliver @item{Logs} to @loc{Chuck & Jack's} 3 times.
Deliver @item{Wood Shavings} to @loc{Page & Price Paper} 3 times.

achievements.description: Complete a delivery to 5 different companies in Hot Springs (requires Arkansas DLC)
achievements.summary: Make deliveries to 5 different companies located in Hot Springs, Arkansas.

guide.context: The company Shop Town does not count.

steps.text: Deliver to five different companies in @loc{Hot Springs}.

achievements.description: Complete the first scenario of the first chapter in Truck Driving Basics (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish scenario 1 of chapter 1 of the Truck Driving Basics course in the Driving Academy.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Driving Academy}, pick Truck Driving Basics, and finish the first scenario of chapter 1.

achievements.description: Complete at least 6 scenarios in the fourth chapter of Truck Driving Basics while using only the interior camera (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish 6 or more scenarios of chapter 4 of Truck Driving Basics using no camera but the interior one.

steps.text: Switch to the interior camera and do not change it during a scenario.
Finish the first six scenarios of chapter 4.

achievements.description: Complete at least 28 scenarios in Truck Driving Basics including the final exams (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish 28 or more Truck Driving Basics scenarios in the Driving Academy, counting the final exams.

steps.text: Play through every Truck Driving Basics scenario and both final exams.

achievements.description: Complete any scenario in fourth chapter of Truck Driving Basics in one attempt without correcting by driving forward (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish a chapter 4 scenario of Truck Driving Basics on the first attempt, never driving forward to correct your position.

steps.text: Do the first scenario of chapter 4 and finish it on the first attempt without driving forward to fix your position.

achievements.description: Complete 20 scenarios in chapters two, three or four of Truck Driving Basics using an H-shifter or sequential transmission (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish 20 scenarios from chapters 2, 3 or 4 of Truck Driving Basics while driving with an H-shifter or sequential gearbox.

steps.text: In the options menu, change the transmission from automatic to H-shifter or sequential.
Finish 20 scenarios from chapters 2, 3 or 4.

achievements.description: Complete any 5 scenarios in a row without failure from the third or fourth chapter in Truck Driving Basics (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Complete 5 scenarios in a row without failing, from the third or fourth chapter of Truck Driving Basics.

steps.text: Play the first five scenarios of chapter 3 back to back without a failure.

achievements.description: Discover at least 10 cities in Missouri (requires Missouri DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 10 or more different cities in Missouri to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Missouri cities until 10 are discovered, for example @loc{St. Louis}, @loc{St. Joseph}, @loc{Springfield}, @loc{Rolla}, @loc{Poplar Bluff}, @loc{Maryville}, @loc{Kirksville}, @loc{Kansas City}, @loc{Joplin}, @loc{Jefferson City}, @loc{Columbia}, @loc{Cape Girardeau}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 12 viewpoints in Missouri (requires Missouri DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 12 different viewpoints in Missouri.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Missouri and watch their cutscenes until 12 are viewed, such as @loc{St. Louis}, @loc{St. Joseph}, @loc{Springfield}, @loc{Sedalia}, @loc{Rolla}, @loc{Poplar Bluff}, @loc{Ozark Lakes}, @loc{Maryville}, @loc{Kirksville}, @loc{Kansas City Underground}, @loc{Kansas City}, @loc{Joplin}, @loc{Jefferson City}, @loc{Highland Farms}, @loc{Columbia}.

achievements.description: Complete a delivery to at least 2 underground Terrastore warehouses (requires Missouri DLC)
achievements.summary: Make deliveries to 2 or more underground Terrastore warehouses in Missouri.

steps.text: Deliver cargo to underground @loc{Terrastore} warehouses in two of these cities: @loc{Joplin}, @loc{Kansas City}, @loc{Springfield}, @loc{St. Louis}.

achievements.description: Deliver ammonia and sulphuric acid to Namiq in Joplin, then complete a dynamite delivery from it (requires Missouri DLC)
achievements.summary: Bring ammonia and sulphuric acid to the Namiq site in Joplin, then haul a dynamite load away from that site.

steps.text: Deliver an @item{Ammonia} job and a @item{Sulphuric Acid} job to @loc{NAMIQ} in @loc{Joplin}.
steps.note: Tank trailers (gas or D-shaped) make matching jobs easier to spot near Joplin or Columbia.

steps.text: Then take a @item{Dynamite} job from the same @loc{NAMIQ} site and deliver it.

achievements.description: Complete the pass conditions in at least 23 scenarios in Truck Driving Proficiency (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Meet the pass requirements in 23 or more Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios.

steps.text: Open Truck Driving Proficiency in the @mechanic{Driving Academy} and pass 23 scenarios.

achievements.description: Obtain 3 stars in at least 15 scenarios in Truck Driving Proficiency (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Obtain 3 stars in at least 15 scenarios in Truck Driving Proficiency.

steps.text: Replay Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios until 15 of them show 3 stars.

achievements.description: Obtain 3 stars in any 3 scenarios played in a row in Truck Driving Proficiency (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Earn 3 stars on each of 3 consecutive Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios.

steps.text: Play three Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios back to back and earn 3 stars in each.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Iowa (requires Iowa DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 8 or more different cities in Iowa to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Iowa cities until 8 are discovered, for example @loc{Iowa City}, @loc{Fort Dodge}, @loc{Dubuque}, @loc{Des Moines}, @loc{Davenport}, @loc{Council Bluffs}, @loc{Cedar Rapids}, @loc{Burlington}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 8 viewpoints in Iowa (requires Iowa DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 8 different viewpoints in Iowa.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Iowa and watch their cutscenes until 8 are viewed, such as @loc{Waterloo}, @loc{Traer}, @loc{Spencer}, @loc{Oskaloosa}, @loc{Dubuque Lock & Dam 11}, @loc{Dream Field}, @loc{Davenport}, @loc{Cedar Rapids}, @loc{Burlington}, @loc{Auburn}.

achievements.description: Cross the iconic bridge in Iowa (requires Iowa DLC)
achievements.summary: Cross the Madison County Bridge in Iowa.

steps.text: Drive across the @loc{Madison County Bridge}, which lies on the road between Council Bluffs and Des Moines.

achievements.description: Complete a live pigs cargo delivery from two livestock farms in Iowa (requires Iowa DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver live pigs from two different livestock farms in Iowa.

steps.text: Take a live pigs job from the @loc{Evergreen} farm in Council Bluffs or Fort Dodge and deliver it.
Take a second live pigs job from a different farm, such as @loc{Grand Pastures} in Iowa City, and deliver it.
steps.note: The destination does not have to be in Iowa.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Louisiana (requires Louisiana DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 8 or more different cities in Louisiana to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Louisiana cities until 8 are discovered, for example @loc{Shreveport}, @loc{Port Fourchon}, @loc{New Orleans}, @loc{Natchitoches}, @loc{Monroe}, @loc{Lake Charles}, @loc{Lafayette}, @loc{Houma}, @loc{DeRidder}, @loc{Baton Rouge}, @loc{Alexandria}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 8 viewpoints in Louisiana (requires Louisiana DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 8 different viewpoints in Louisiana.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Louisiana until 8 cutscenes are viewed, such as @loc{Shreveport}, @loc{Port Fourchon}, @loc{Old River Dams}, @loc{New Orleans}, @loc{Lake Pontchartrain}, @loc{Lake Charles}, @loc{Houma}, @loc{Baton Rouge}, @loc{Avery Island}, @loc{Atchafalaya Basin}.

achievements.description: Cross two draw bridges in Louisiana (requires Louisiana DLC)
achievements.summary: Cross two draw bridges in Louisiana.

steps.text: Cross the draw bridge on Highway 80 in @loc{Monroe}.
Cross the draw bridge where LA 661 meets LA 315 in @loc{Houma}.

achievements.description: Deliver iron pipes, metal coils, and lumber to any shipyard in Louisiana for oil tanker construction (requires Louisiana DLC)
achievements.summary: Take three cargoes to a shipyard in Louisiana: iron pipes, metal coils and lumber, which go into oil tanker construction.

steps.text: Take @item{Lumber}, @item{Iron Pipes} and @item{Metal Coils} to a Haddock Shipyard, in @loc{Port Fourchon} or @loc{Houma}.
steps.note: Search the job list for each cargo name.

achievements.description: Complete at least 12 scenarios in Double Trailer Handling (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish 12 or more scenarios of the Double Trailer Handling course in the Driving Academy.

steps.text: Open Double Trailer Handling in the @mechanic{Driving Academy} and finish 12 scenarios.

achievements.description: Discover at least 8 cities in Illinois (requires Illinois DLC)
achievements.summary: Drive into 8 or more different cities in Illinois to find them.

steps.text: Drive to Illinois cities until 8 are discovered, for example @loc{Quincy}, @loc{Springfield}, @loc{Rockford}, @loc{Peoria}, @loc{Moline}, @loc{Marion}, @loc{Effingham}, @loc{East St. Louis}, @loc{Chicago}, @loc{Champaign}, @loc{Bloomington}.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 12 viewpoints in Illinois (requires Illinois DLC)
achievements.summary: View cutscenes from at least 12 different viewpoints in Illinois.

steps.text: Visit viewpoints in Illinois and watch their cutscenes until 12 are viewed.

achievements.description: Perfectly deliver any machinery: Springfield (IL) - Peoria, then Peoria - Chicago (NAMIQ quarry) (requires Illinois DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver machinery with no damage and no fines from Springfield to Peoria, then from Peoria to the NAMIQ quarry in Chicago.

steps.text: Deliver a machinery job from @loc{Springfield} to @loc{Peoria} with no damage and no fines.
Deliver a machinery job from @loc{Peoria} to the @loc{NAMIQ} quarry in @loc{Chicago} the same way.
steps.note: Turning off fines and fees in the options makes this easier.

achievements.description: Drive to the center of the Evergreen cornfield maze (requires Illinois DLC)
achievements.summary: Reach the middle of the Evergreen cornfield maze in Illinois.

steps.text: Drive to the cornfield maze near the Evergreen farm east of @loc{Marion} and go to its center.

achievements.description: Discover at least 10 cities in South Dakota (requires South Dakota DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 10 cities in South Dakota.

steps.text: Drive into ten South Dakota cities.

achievements.description: View cutscenes from at least 10 viewpoints in South Dakota (requires South Dakota DLC)
achievements.summary: View the cutscene at 10 different viewpoints in South Dakota.

steps.text: Drive to ten South Dakota viewpoints and watch each cutscene.

achievements.description: Complete two undamaged deliveries in this order: Mobridge - Pierre, Pierre - Yankton (requires South Dakota DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete two undamaged deliveries in order: Mobridge to Pierre, then Pierre to Yankton.

steps.text: Deliver a job from @loc{Mobridge} to @loc{Pierre} with no damage.
Then deliver a job from @loc{Pierre} to @loc{Yankton} with no damage.

achievements.displayName: Who Says You Can’t Go Home?
achievements.description: Deliver two different types of cargo to the residential construction sites in Watertown or Spearfish (requires South Dakota DLC)
achievements.summary: Bring two different cargo types to a residential construction site in Watertown or Spearfish.

steps.text: Deliver one cargo type to a residential construction site in @loc{Watertown} or @loc{Spearfish}.
Deliver a second, different cargo type to a residential construction site there.

achievements.description: Deliver 5 unique cargoes using a car (requires Road Trip DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver five different kinds of cargo with a car.

steps.text: Deliver five different cargoes in a car.

achievements.description: Earn a Postcard by completing a Tourist Board (requires Road Trip DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish a Tourist Board to receive a Postcard.

steps.text: Complete a @mechanic{Tourist Board} to earn a Postcard.

achievements.description: Own your first car (requires Road Trip DLC)
achievements.summary: Own your first car.

steps.text: Buy a car in Road Trip mode.

achievements.description: Drive 5,000 miles or earn 50,000 dollars using any car (requires Road Trip DLC)
achievements.summary: Reach 5,000 miles driven, or $50,000 earned, while using a car.

steps.text: Drive in a car and take jobs until you reach 5,000 miles or $50,000.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo with a 5-star rating 5 times in a row using any car (requires Road Trip DLC)
achievements.summary: Get a 5-star rating on five car deliveries in a row.

steps.text: Deliver 5 car jobs in a row, each with a 5-star rating.

achievements.description: Complete 20 consecutive jobs without a fine in any car (requires Road Trip DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish 20 jobs in a row with a car without receiving a single fine.

steps.text: Complete 20 car jobs in a row without a fine.
